item.title: Hundreds attend vigil for missing Savannah Guthrie’s mother
item.description: Hundreds gathered at a Tucson church vigil as FBI agents returned to Nancy Guthrie's home with K9 units. Investigators are examining a ransom note demanding millions in Bitcoin. (2/4/26)

item.title: Police: Parents arrested after 5-year-old child dies, more charges pending
item.description: MARIETTA, Ga. (Court TV) — A mother and father are facing multiple charges after their 5-year-old son was pronounced deceased on Wednesday. Michael Horn and Alexiss Eitrem, both 31, were arrested on charges of battery and abuse. Marietta police said additional charges are pending as of Thursday as the investigation continues. item.title: Sheriff: Nancy Guthrie is ‘still out there,’ but no suspects
item.description: TUCSON, Ariz. (AP) — Investigators believe the missing mother of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie is “still out there,” but they have not identified any suspects, a sheriff in Arizona said Thursday. item.title: No texts, no fraud: Meggan Sundwall scores big win before murder trial
item.description: HIGHLAND, Utah (Court TV) — In the final hearing ahead of her murder trial, Meggan Sundwall‘s defense successfully convinced a judge to keep some bad facts out of her murder trial while allowing some key evidence in. item.title: Meggan Sundwall’s Defense Scores Wins Ahead of Murder Trial
item.description: A judge suppressed evidence of Meggan Sundwall's alleged timecard fraud but will allow evidence of the victim's alleged theft. Sundwall is charged with murder in the death of her friend, Kacee Terry. (2/5/26)

item.title: FBI: $50,000 Reward for Information Leading to Nancy Guthrie
item.description: Authorities give an update on the search for 'Today' host Savannah Guthrie's mother, Nancy Guthrie, saying 'we have not identified a suspect.' The FBI announced a $50,000 reward for information leading to the recovery of Nancy and arrest and conviction of anyone involved. (2/5/26)
